integrity: The theorem is supported by a complete symbolic counting argument; two independent finite enumerators corroborate low-dimensional cases but cannot prove the asymptotic limit.
scientific_limitations: Dimension tends to infinity with field size fixed. Uniformly distributed invertible structure matrices only. The explicit probability upper bound is not asserted sharp; the result does not quantify the singular-matrix random model or automorphism group schemes. Previous exact Burnside formulas and the monomiality lemma are not new.
title: Exponential rigidity and orbit asymptotics for random perfect evolution algebras
